name: Your Turn To Die: Zero Percent
source:
A Fangame retelling Your Turn To Die: Death Game by Majority, from the perspective of our favorite loner, "Sou Hiyori"

The game plot and events have not changed but have been remastered with new art and internal dialogue, giving more insight into how our new protagonist may have viewed things

[From [url=https://kumiamii.itch.io/your-turn-to-die-zero-percent]itch.io[/url]]
